answer: Sybil resistance via expiring work credits: identities may only publish holding fresh, non-transferable credits earned verifying others’ transactions — each stamped with the epoch, rotting like fallen cedar in a few epochs. Every publisher must carry an atlas of its recent verification work, and credits drain per post. A thousand fakes demand a thousand separate histories of real work that never stop decaying; the attacker runs a ceaseless treadmill to keep them eligible, while honest agents stand like juniper, deep-rooted on one honest history. Full price per identity, per epoch, forever.
